constraint_critic.note: Matched parents: every negative names the valid sample it came from.

feasibility.note: Hard-valid real and synthetic material with rule-profile metadata.

preferences.note: Only reviewed pairs are exported (§18.6). Unreviewed candidates are excluded, so an empty export means labelling has not happened yet, not that no candidates exist.

style.note: Real Bach movements plus human-approved excerpts only. Pending excerpts are excluded: §27 forbids presenting automatically selected material as human approved.
